language.title: Language
language.subtitle: Choose the language of the app interface.

profile.title: Profile photo
profile.subtitle: Choose a photo that will appear in the app menu.

notif.title: Push notifications
notif.subtitle: Get reminders for your appointments directly on this device, even when the app is closed.
notif.unsupported: Notifications are not supported on this browser.
notif.denied: Permission denied. Allow notifications in your browser settings.

currency.title: Currency
currency.subtitle: Select the currency used to display amounts in your app.

modules.title: Modules
modules.subtitle: Enable or hide optional modules to keep only the ones your family uses.
modules.parentOnly: Only parents can change the modules.

descriptions.budget: Family budget tracking, expenses and income.
descriptions.integrations: Connections to third-party services (Mealie, Home Assistant…).
descriptions.kiosk: Full-screen display for a shared home screen.
descriptions.notes: Sticky notes shown on the dashboard.
descriptions.ai: Smart assistant to quickly capture and organize.

export.title: Export data
export.subtitle: Download a portable JSON copy of your family data and family-wide preferences. Authentication credentials, integration secrets, notifications, and temporary security data are not included.

import.title: Import data
import.subtitle: Restore an OpenFamily portable export. Existing records are kept and duplicates are skipped; family-wide preferences from the file are restored.

support.title: Support OpenFamily
support.subtitle: OpenFamily is free and open source, self-hosted on your own server. If it helps your family, you can support its development — it stays free either way.

regional.title: Week
regional.subtitle: Choose which day your weeks start on, in the calendar, the planning, meals and the dashboard. This setting is yours alone.
regional.weekStartHelp: Automatic follows the conventions of your language and region.
